title: Transcription quality
description: How close Whisper (live, final, with retries, with the text pass) gets to final Gemini, per dataset and over time. Numbers only.

list.name: dataset
list.label: Dataset
list.query: select distinct dataset from obs.transcription_eval order by 1

panels.title: Distance to the reference, by arm
panels.description: Share of reference words the arm gets wrong (substitutions, deletions, insertions). The reference is final Gemini on the whole audio, or the human text for read speech. Lower is better.

targets.rawSql: select ran_at as time, arm as metric, wer_to_reference * 100 as value from obs.transcription_eval where $__timeFilter(ran_at) and dataset = '$dataset' and rec = '*'  and wer_to_reference is not null order by 1

panels.title: Distance at the 30 second joins
panels.description: The same, in 5 seconds around each place where the recorder's 30 second pieces meet.

targets.rawSql: select ran_at as time, arm as metric, join_wer * 100 as value from obs.transcription_eval where $__timeFilter(ran_at) and dataset = '$dataset' and rec = '*'  and join_wer is not null order by 1

panels.title: Pieces cut without a pause, per audio hour
panels.description: Final pieces that ended without a pause in reach, so a word could be cut. Fixed finder: a pause is 0.3 s under -35 dB. Adaptive: a pause is 0.3 s under a threshold learned from the recording.

targets.rawSql: select ran_at as time, arm as metric, hard_cuts_per_hour as value from obs.transcription_eval where $__timeFilter(ran_at) and dataset = '$dataset' and rec = '*' and hard_cuts is not null and hard_cuts_per_hour is not null order by 1

panels.title: Cost per audio hour
panels.description: EUR per hour of audio: Whisper per minute, the GLM text pass per token, Gemini per token.

targets.rawSql: select ran_at as time, arm as metric, cost_per_hour_eur as value from obs.transcription_eval where $__timeFilter(ran_at) and dataset = '$dataset' and rec = '*'  and cost_per_hour_eur is not null order by 1

panels.title: Retries of doubtful stretches
panels.description: Stretches Whisper itself doubted (mean log probability under -1, or compression ratio over 2.4), what the retries did, and seconds sent again, newest run per arm.

targets.rawSql: select arm, to_char(ran_at at time zone 'Europe/Amsterdam','MM-DD HH24:MI') as run, retry_spans as stretches, retry_attempts as attempts, retry_improved as improved, retry_kept as "first kept", retry_failed as failed from obs.transcription_eval t where dataset = '$dataset' and rec = '*' and arm like '%retry%' and ran_at = (select max(ran_at) from obs.transcription_eval where dataset = t.dataset and arm = t.arm and rec = '*') order by arm

panels.title: Latest run, per recording
panels.description: Distance to the reference per recording, newest run. Noise floor is the 10th percentile level of the recording in dB: higher means a noisier room.

targets.rawSql: select rec, round(avg(noise_floor_db)::numeric,1) as "noise floor dB", round((max(wer_to_reference) filter (where arm='live_whisper')*100)::numeric,1) as "live whisper %", round((max(wer_to_reference) filter (where arm='final_whisper_fixed_finder')*100)::numeric,1) as "final, fixed finder %", round((max(wer_to_reference) filter (where arm='final_whisper')*100)::numeric,1) as "final whisper %", round((max(wer_to_reference) filter (where arm='final_whisper_retry_glm')*100)::numeric,1) as "whisper + retry + glm %", max(hard_cuts) filter (where arm='final_whisper_fixed_finder') as "hard cuts fixed", max(hard_cuts) filter (where arm='final_whisper') as "hard cuts adaptive" from obs.transcription_eval where dataset = '$dataset' and rec <> '*' and run_id = (select run_id from obs.transcription_eval where dataset = '$dataset' order by ran_at desc limit 1) group by rec order by 2 desc
